title: Proposal Submit Request
description: Normative transport wrapper for submitting one canonical Governed Action Proposal to an AGCP-conformant implementation. The wrapper supplies transport correlation and namespace-qualified extension data only; all governance-domain content is carried in proposal and validated by DS-021. Submission is not execution and does not confer authority at commitment.
$comment: DS-013 is intentionally limited to transport-envelope concerns. The authoritative proposal domain object is DS-021 governed_action_proposal.json. Implementations migrating from the former flattened DS-013 representation SHALL wrap the canonical proposal under proposal. The obsolete top-level metadata compatibility member is not permitted; namespace-qualified extension data SHALL use extensions.
x-agcp-schema-role: Governed Action Proposal Submission Transport Wrapper

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespace-qualified transport or implementation extension members. Extensions SHALL NOT alter, replace, or weaken the canonical Governed Action Proposal carried in proposal.

proposal.description: The canonical Governed Action Proposal domain object defined by DS-021.

submitted_at.description: Optional client-declared submission time. This value is transport metadata and does not replace authoritative receipt, ordering, or Governance Ledger timestamps.

client_request_id.description: Optional client-side correlation identifier. This is not a substitute for transport-level Idempotency-Key requirements or Proposal Identity.
